name: Diplopic Serum
body:
Price 250 gp; Weight —

ABOUT

Herbalists accidentally created diplopic serum while attempting to devise a treatment for cataracts. Derived from dew of lunary, this aromatic pink serum temporarily affects a creature’s vision systems, in addition to temporarily impairing its mental faculties.

DETAILS

Type poison, injury; Save Fortitude DC 15 Frequency 1/round for 6 rounds; Cure 1 save

EFFECTS

1d2 Wis damage. Additionally, the creature has double vision, imposing a 50% miss chance on its attacks against all opponents. Blind creatures are unaffected by this additional effect
